P140.title: 铁路列车-轨道-基础结构动力相互作用统一分析Part I:动力学模型构造与求解
P140.label: 徐磊（2023）

complete_examples.text: The track and substructures were simulated and assembled with different types of finite elements, and the position of the element was directly controlled by the element nodal coordinates with the sizes calculated.

By considering the train, track, and substructures as an integrated system, the coupled vehicle-track dynamics theory was taken as the core of the method, and the principle of total potential energy with a stationary value and the “set-in-right-position” rule for matrix formation were taken as the modeling methodology.
总之,仍有必要建立完善的列车−轨道−基础结构相互作用模型,以满足日益复杂的铁路列车与下部结构动力学分析需求。
研究结果表明:该统一模型能较好地反映轮轨高频振动特性,且能开展多基础结构形式下的列车-轨道-基础结构耦合动力学分析,具有工程可靠性和适用性。
